reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 220 for the 715-receiver graph. The lower bound is an independent set of size 220, and the upper bound is a linear code over F_5 (M = I + 4A) of length 220. All four checks pass: independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding. The agent needed one try_code, with a single critic round. Wall time was 104.3 s, of which 69.0 s was LLM time and 35.3 s compute. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also proved 220, in 12.2 s, so it was faster but gives only the lower bound. The cover-based baselines were not proven (604 and 635 against 220). F2 minrank SAT reached only 219. The earlier kushagra_agent also closed at 220 over F_5 in 0.28 s, so it was much faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
